fields.description: Vida Residences Club Point brings the Vida design identity to a twin-tower apartment development in Dubai Hills Estate. Its one to three bedroom homes are supported by gardens, shared lounges and spaces for exercise and socialising. The official plans also include a lower-rise Block C alongside the main towers.

overview: The brochure puts shared spaces at the centre of the scheme: a lobby lounge, gardens, a community room and places to gather outdoors. Large windows and balconies connect the apartments with the surrounding greenery and skyline. Vida’s influence is presented through the design and social atmosphere; the material reviewed does not establish an included hotel-service package or rental-management agreement.
research.locationNote: The development is in Dubai Hills Estate near the golf-course neighbourhood. Dubai Hills Park, the mall and golf club are district destinations, with Al Khail Road providing wider access. Confirm walking routes and the selected apartment’s outlook; proximity does not imply club membership or an unobstructed view.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 1.61m. The launch sheet lists AED 1.61m, AED 2.32m and AED 3.4m category starts for one, two and three bedrooms. These historical starts are not current availability or booking offers.
research.paymentNote: The published launch schedule is 80% before completion and 20% at completion, including two 5% instalments. Confirm the remaining obligations for the particular transaction.
research.handoverNote: The launch sheet and Property Finder indicate February 2029. Bayut’s payment table instead ends in March 2029. Q1 2029 is therefore shown as reported, with the precise contractual date requiring confirmation.

facts.label: Published apartment mix
facts.value: 371 one-bedroom, 215 two-bedroom and 86 three-bedroom homes total 672 apartments. This is the planned mix, not remaining stock.

facts.label: A larger balcony option
facts.value: A113 has a 1,352.27 sq ft suite and 461.02 sq ft balcony, totalling 1,813.29 sq ft. Its three-bedroom layout includes a maid’s room, bathroom, powder room and laundry.

facts.label: Lower-rise three-bedroom layouts
facts.value: Block C includes ground and two podium levels. Type 2G has two balconies and a maid’s room; it is an apartment layout, not a townhouse.

facts.label: Dated portal status
facts.value: Property Finder’s progress update is dated January 2026 and its sold-out label refers to developer stock. Neither is treated as a current inspection or a bar to possible resales.
